review_scope: Only two modified native integration tests and their RM-158 registry source-fence test contract; source unchanged.

checks.race_proof: Both marker-first and fence-first cases hold one native transaction after its source guard/marker or erasure fence insert; a second client is observed at PostgreSQL advisory-lock execute or MongoDB transactional event-counter write before the blocked assertion; the first commits, then the second commits or rejects according to order.
checks.negative_cases: Missing, foreign, stale and fenced source pins reject with no private name in the event log on each backend.
checks.postconditions: Marker-first path scrubs private name after fence; both orderings contain a fence, and third/reopened client rejects fresh marker append.
checks.owned_scratch: Existing fixtures verify owned project/service/owner labels, loopback host port and scratch database identity, then drop disposable PG/Mongo database.

limitations: Focused 12-case native proof only; not full erasure copy-class, production, all-suite or Phase C acceptance.
